criteria.statement: playwright is an exact-pinned root devDependency and package-lock.json records it
scripts/smoke-browser.mjs exists, npm run smoke:browser runs it, and it does not import smoke-built-server or a module extracted from it
scripts/smoke-built-server.mjs is unchanged by this slice
One absolute output path is computed by the script and used for the build, vite preview, screenshots and CI artifact; nothing is written to apps/frontend/dist
When Chrome cannot launch the script exits non-zero with a clear message, covered by a unit test
The not-Camera-unavailable assertion is a separate droppable function; a unit test shows other scanner checks do not depend on it
scripts/smoke-browser.test.mjs passes inside npm run test:scripts
npm run smoke:browser passes locally: six steps at both widths, zero console errors, zero failed local requests
quality:check runs smoke:browser, and typecheck, lint and format:check pass
quality-check.yml has the browser-smoke job (Node 24, no secrets, no id-token, 7-day failure artifact of .tmp/browser-smoke/) and deploy.needs lists it; ci-workflow-parity passes
The accepted NFR-021, REQ-166, NFR-012, system-map and runtime-process-hygiene text is in place
Browser closed, owned servers stopped, ports released after the local run; output path recorded
Nothing the PR ships is under PRD/work/
